exports.geminiLiveConvertingSttAdapter: the instance registration wires: the default adapter plus source upload conversion (ffmpeg, pipe-only) before any credential use or socket
exports.createGeminiLiveSttAdapter: factory; options { WebSocketImpl, agentFactory, timeoutMs, socketOptions, convertAudio } for tests; no convertAudio keeps the WAV-only contract
exports.createGeminiLiveConvertingSttAdapter: factory for the conversion-enabled adapter; options as createGeminiLiveSttAdapter plus { converterOptions }
exports.createGeminiLiveAudioConverter: ({ spawn, access, timeoutMs, maxInputBytes, maxPcmBytes, reapMs }) -> (bytes, { signal, deadlineAt }) => { wav } | local error result
exports.sniffGeminiLiveUpload: (Buffer) -> wav | mp3 | flac | ogg | m4a | webm | aac | null, from magic bytes only
exports.geminiLiveFfmpegArgs: (container) -> fixed ffmpeg argv: pipe-only protocol, one forced whitelisted demuxer, s16le mono 16 kHz to stdout
exports.GEMINI_LIVE_FFMPEG_CANDIDATES: fixed absolute ffmpeg locations; no PATH lookup
exports.GEMINI_LIVE_FFMPEG_ENV: the whole child environment (no inherited variables, no credentials)
exports.GEMINI_LIVE_FFMPEG_MISSING_MESSAGE: local 503 text when no candidate is executable
exports.GEMINI_LIVE_FFMPEG_REAP_MS: wait for a killed child to be reaped before returning
exports.GEMINI_LIVE_UPLOAD_CONTAINERS: sniffed container -> the one demuxer allowed for it
exports.buildGeminiLiveTranscriptionRequest: async (model, formData, { kind }) -> { plan } or a local 400/413/415 error result
exports.buildGeminiLiveSetupFrame: ({ model, language, prompt }) -> source setup frame
exports.extractPcmFrom16kWav: (Buffer) -> PCM samples of a 16 kHz 16-bit mono PCM WAV, or null
exports.runGeminiLiveSocket: socket driver; never rejects; resolves { outcome, sent, setupSent, text, usage? }
exports.geminiLiveHandshakeRefusal: (status, { secrets, retryAfter }) upgrade refusal mapping that never quotes the upstream
exports.GEMINI_LIVE_STT_CONFIG: staged sttConfig fragment (fixed URL, format gemini-live-stt, translationModels [])

conversion.source: geminiLiveTranscribe.ts convertToPcm16k: WAV fast path, else ffmpeg pipe:0 -> s16le mono 16 kHz pipe:1, -protocol_whitelist pipe, 60 s timeout, 8 KiB stderr cap, PCM cap, SIGKILL on timeout/abort/overflow; runs before the socket URL/headers are resolved
conversion.wiredBy: geminiLiveConvertingSttAdapter (registration); geminiLiveSttAdapter keeps the WAV-only contract
conversion.bypass: an upload extractPcmFrom16kWav accepts is never converted
conversion.executable: first executable of /usr/bin/ffmpeg, /usr/local/bin/ffmpeg, /opt/homebrew/bin/ffmpeg; no PATH lookup, no caller value
conversion.argv: fixed array; only the forced demuxer (-f and -format_whitelist) varies, from the container table; filename and content type are ignored
conversion.isolation: shell false, cwd /, env { LC_ALL: C, AV_LOG_FORCE_NOCOLOR: 1 } only, stdio pipes only, no temp files
conversion.failures: all local (never an account fault, no acceptedJob): 415 unknown container, 400 undecodable or empty, 413 over 600 s or 25 MiB, 504 timeout, 499 abort, 503 ffmpeg missing, 500 malformed converter output
conversion.limitations: M4A/MP4 whose moov atom follows the media data cannot be read from a pipe (source has the same limit); Windows hosts have no candidate path and get the 503 capability error
